name: Discovery Call Prep
summary: Prepares a one-page brief and question plan for a first sales call with a specific prospect.
description: Combines what you know about the prospect with your ICP to produce hypotheses about their pains, questions that test those hypotheses, and qualification criteria to listen for. It never presents guesses about the prospect as facts; anything not supplied is labelled a hypothesis.
problems: I don't know what to ask on a discovery call
My first calls turn into demos too early
I need to qualify leads faster

inputs.label: Prospect
inputs.description: The company and person you're meeting.
inputs.example: Dana Lee, COO at Brightline Agency (35 people)

inputs.label: What you know
inputs.description: Anything you already know: how they found you, what they said, their website.
inputs.example: Booked after reading our post on month-end close; mentioned spreadsheets.

outputs.label: Call brief
outputs.description: Hypotheses, questions mapped to each, qualification criteria and next-step options.

steps.name: Prepare brief
steps.responsibility: Draft hypotheses and questions from the prospect notes and ICP.

steps.name: Check labels
steps.responsibility: Ensure statements not grounded in the notes are labelled as hypotheses.

dependencies.reason: The ICP's pains and disqualifiers sharpen the questions.

criteria.description: Claims about the prospect that aren't in the notes are labelled hypotheses.
Each hypothesis has at least one question that tests it.
